content: Naming conventions in variant handling patterns During the variant handling model transformation some connectors from the metaclasses partic- ipating in the variant handling pattern to other metaclasses are created. Those other metaclasses either exist already in the annotated metamodel or they are created during the tranformation. The already existing metaclasses are the following: • VariationPoint (for Property Set Pattern, Aggregation Pattern, and Associa- tion Pattern) • {Type}ValueVariationPoint (for Attribute Value Pattern: {Type} as stated in [TPS_GST_00205]) • AbstractEnumerationValueVariationPoint (for Attribute Value Pattern) During the transformation these metaclasses are connected by naming convention i.e. need to be found by their class name in the annotated metamodel. Therefore the transformation relies on the existence and uniqueness (by class name) of these meta- classes.
